 Bulls vs. Bears: NVIDIA sparks valuation debate as stock nears six-month low
 Nov 07, 2026, 12:43 PM ET NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) Stock By : Dulan Lokuwithana , SA News Editor 23 Comments Justin Sullivan/Getty Images News
 Nvidia ( NVDA ) recorded its sixth consecutive weekly drop this week amid a broader selloff in the U.S. tech sector, adding to the sharp losses the company recorded in October, which also happened to be its worst monthly decline for this year. With its
 Search field Entering text into the input field will update the search result below Quick Insights
 Does Nvidia's current share price offer attractive upside? 
 Bullish analysts see significant upside, citing fair-value estimates above the current price and strong AI-driven growth. A bearish estimate finds the stock overvalued by 11%. 
 Can Nvidia sustain growth amid AI demand and supply constraints? 
 Analysts point to robust AI demand, constrained supply, and potential SpaceX data-center spending as growth drivers. One analyst says customer demand exceeds Nvidia's production capacity. 
 Could competition, financing risks, or credit stress undermine Nvidia's outlook? 
 Bearish analysts cite custom silicon, China market-share losses, stressed neocloud customers, financing constraints, and rising implied default risk as threats to growth and valuation.
